verdict.rationale: Baseten documents deploying open-source, fine-tuned, or custom models on dedicated GPUs. Truss packages model code, weights, and dependencies and ships them with `truss push` or `baseten model push`, and checkpoints from training jobs can be deployed as production endpoints with one CLI command. Missing for 10: explicit LoRA adapter serving or multi-adapter support, detailed docs on how custom weights are uploaded or sourced (e.g., from storage), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
